The '''1965 [[Eliteserien|1. divisjon]]''' was the 22nd completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
It was contested by 10 teams, and [[Skeid Fotball|Skeid]] won the championship, their first title. Both newcomers, [[Lisleby FK|Lisleby]] and [[IL Hødd|Hødd]], were relegated back to the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]].
